Question: Which product category has the highest average item price? Use the English name.
text:
```sql
/*  Find the product category (English name) with the highest average item price  */
SELECT 
    c.name_en          AS category_name,
    AVG(p.price)       AS avg_price
FROM 
    products   AS p
JOIN 
    categories AS c
      ON p.category_id = c.category_id
GROUP BY 
    c.category_id, c.name_en
ORDER BY 
    avg_price DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
